Name: (AT) More Bunniez
Author: catmoss
Description:
[b][size=4]Features:[/size][/b]

Adds options for the plush bunny! 
Includes: Vanilla Alt, Black, Gray, White, Brown, Weed, Emo, Blueberry, Lavender and Peach. 
Feel free to drop suggestions for more themes in the comments if you'd like! 
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/kN5Ynfu.png[/img]﻿[/center]

[/size]
[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] is required for this mod to work.
﻿Buy a paint bucket from Robin and left click on the plushy bunny while holding the paint bucket.
